chapters.summary: Paul praises God for the spiritual blessings given to us in Christ, and prays that believers would truly know the hope of God's calling and the greatness of his power.
keyPoints: God chose us in Christ before the foundation of the world, and predestined us to be adopted as his sons.
In Christ we have redemption through his blood and the forgiveness of sins, and are sealed with the promised Holy Spirit.
Paul gives thanks and prays for believers, that they would know the hope of God's calling and the surpassing greatness of his resurrection power.
chapters.application: Remind yourself each day that in Christ you already possess every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places, and let that truth shape a life of gratitude and hope.

chapters.summary: This chapter describes how mankind was dead in sin, but God in his love and grace, through Christ's redemption, reconciled believers to himself and made them fellow citizens with the saints.
keyPoints: We were once dead in our trespasses and sins, following the ways of the world and the devil, and were by nature children of wrath.
God, who is rich in mercy, because of his great love made us alive together with Christ, raising us up and seating us with him in the heavenly places.
We are saved by grace through faith, not by works, so that we are God's workmanship, created for good works.
chapters.application: Our salvation is God's gift, not our own achievement. Let us do good with a grateful heart, pursue peace with others, and live out unity within the church.

chapters.summary: Paul explains the mystery of the gospel - that the Gentiles are fellow heirs of the promise in Christ - describes his own ministry of this mystery, and prays that believers would be rooted in love, know the love of Christ, and be filled with all the fullness of God.
keyPoints: Paul is a prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of the Gentiles, entrusted with the stewardship of God's grace.
The mystery of the gospel has now been revealed: through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs, members of the same body, and partakers of the promise in Christ.
Paul prays that believers would be strengthened in their inner being, come to know the love of Christ, and be filled with all the fullness of God.
chapters.application: Let us regularly pray for fellow believers, asking God to strengthen us by his Spirit and root us in love, so that we may experience the immeasurable love of Christ and God may be glorified in the church.

chapters.summary: Paul urges believers to live a life worthy of their calling, to maintain unity in Christ, and to put off the old self and put on the new.
keyPoints: Walk in a manner worthy of the calling you have received, with all humility, gentleness, and patience.
United together in Christ, each member is to fulfill his role, building up the body of Christ.
Put off the old self, be renewed in the spirit of your mind, and put on the new self, created to live in true righteousness and holiness.
chapters.application: Today, let us bear with one another in humility and love, and make every effort to keep the unity of the Spirit. At the same time, let us depend on the Lord to put off our old habits, being continually renewed in mind and action, so that our lives reflect the likeness of Christ.

chapters.summary: Paul exhorts believers to imitate God and walk in love, to renounce the deeds of darkness, and explains the spiritual significance of the relationship between husband and wife.
keyPoints: Be imitators of God and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself up for us.
Renounce sexual immorality, impurity, greed, and every deed of darkness, and walk as children of light.
Understand what the will of the Lord is, be filled with the Spirit, and submit to one another with praise and thanksgiving.
chapters.application: Examine your words and actions each day to see whether they reflect the love of Christ. Turn away from sin, pursue holiness, and live out mutual submission and honor within your home.

chapters.summary: Paul teaches believers to live out the character of Christ in the home and the workplace, and to put on the whole armor of God to stand against the schemes of the devil.
keyPoints: Children are to honor their parents, and fathers are not to provoke their children to anger, but to bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
Servants are to serve their masters wholeheartedly, and masters are to treat their servants well, since both have the same Master in heaven.
Put on the whole armor of God, stand firm in the strength of the Lord, and pray for all the saints.
chapters.application: In everyday life - at home, at work, or when facing temptation - depend on the mighty power of God. Act in love and submission, and be devoted to prayer, staying alert and thankful.
